title: Most Likely To Eat Santa's Cookies Youth Long Sleeve Tee, Funny Kids Christmas Shirt, Family Matching Holiday Top
description:
We all know who's eating the cookies left out for Santa! A happy gingerbread man with a bite missing and a glass of milk in a tiny Santa hat sit on this playful long-sleeve tee: "MOST LIKELY TO EAT SANTA'S COOKIES".

Part of the much-loved "Most likely to" Christmas series: perfect for matching family pictures, Christmas Eve and holiday parties.

DETAILS
- 100% Airlume combed ring-spun cotton (solid colours), soft and lightweight
- Long sleeves, classic youth fit
- Youth sizes S (about 6-8 years), M (10-12), L (14-16): please check the size chart in the photos
- Front print

CARE
Machine wash cold, inside out. Do not tumble dry on high heat. Do not iron directly on the print.

PRODUCTION AND SHIPPING
Printed on demand by our production partner in the USA and shipped with tracking. Production takes 2-5 business days. This item ships to the USA and Canada.

Design created by MurettoStudio with the help of AI image tools, then checked and prepared for print by me.

Photos: the first photo is the product mockup from our print partner; the lifestyle photos are digital mockups created for illustration.
